name: detectai-document-parser (${environment})
description: FastAPI text extraction: uploads, pages, durations, saturation. service.name = document-parser. :8000.

pages.name: Document parser
pages.description: Upload RED, extraction duration, queue saturation

rawConfiguration.text:
## Document parser (`document-parser`, `${environment}`, port 8000)
Limits: `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES`, `MAX_TEXT_LENGTH`, `MAX_PDF_PAGES`, `EXTRACTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `READINESS_MAX_QUEUE_DEPTH`, `WORKERS`/`WORKER_THREADS`. Health `GET /api/v1/health`. 413 = too large, 422 = unprocessable, timeouts = extraction over budget.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `uploads/min` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS timeouts WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%timeout%' OR message LIKE '%timed out%')

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `mime.type`, `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET `http.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n FACET message WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%upload%' OR message LIKE '%page%' OR message LIKE '%truncat%' OR message LIKE '%too large%') LIMIT 20

FROM Metric SELECT average(parser_queue_depth) AS `queue depth`, average(parser_workers_busy) AS `busy workers` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS `readiness not-ready` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%readiness%' OR message LIKE '%not ready%' OR message LIKE '%queue depth%' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route`, `mime.type` LIMIT 20

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (level = 'error' OR severity = 'ERROR') FACET `http.route` LIMIT 20
